behavior: The web app's files live in screens, features and shared per docs/web/structure.md, with unchanged routes and behavior
acceptance: Routes compose screens; dashboard, balances, activity and landing code live in screens/; auth, profiles, balances, receive, activity and waitlist code live in features/; shared code has a concrete owner; no global types/ or catch-all constants/ and lib/ remain.
Imports follow the direction rules: shared never imports screens or features; a feature does not import another feature's private files.
Unit tests sit beside their sources and the same tests still run; routes, rendered behavior, API calls and the kit are unchanged: lint, typecheck, unit, build, e2e and the live sign-in suite pass.
notes: 2026-10-09 review pass by reviewer: Pure move: routes render the same trees via screens/, copy strings, classes, props, API paths and route exports (metadata, dynamic) unchanged; shared never imports screens/features, the only feature-to-feature import (receive -> balances type) is documented; 3 test files (16 tests) run from src/ beside sources; typecheck, unit and biome clean; no stale old-path references. Non-blocking: unrequested blank-line/import-style churn in moved files and globals.css import moved to the top of app/layout.tsx (no CSS effect), AUTH_COPY.soon reused for app-shell nav, structure.md tree does not list screens/kit-directions on its own line.

2026-10-09 review pass by reviewer: turbo.json: excluding .next/dev/** is correct. Next 16 sets distDir to .next/dev only in PHASE_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER (next/dist/server/config.js); next build and next start use the root .next (BUILD_ID, server, static, manifests), so the cached build output keeps everything next start needs. e2e is unaffected: both playwright configs run 'pnpm build && pnpm start' (next build directly, not via turbo), and apps/web/scripts/e2e.mjs only spawns playwright. structure.md: kit/ and kit-directions/ listed as sibling screens matches the code; no screen imports another screen, shared imports no screens/features. Pure move re-checked: every route page.tsx only renders its screen; old route bodies diff to the new screens only by import paths, the export name, and copy constants moved to their owner (same strings); 'use client' kept on the client screens. web typecheck clean, web unit 3 files/16 tests pass, docs-check 0 errors.

proof.3: unit: tests moved beside sources (features/*/*.test.ts*), vitest include src/**; same 3 files and 16 tests pass; e2e (main 21 + live 8) unchanged and passing
